description: This file defines the Backup class within the Opencart admin model for tools, responsible for database backup operations such as retrieving table names, records, and total record counts.

classes.name: Backup
classes.description: Provides methods to access and retrieve database table information, records, and record counts for backup purposes.

methods.name: getTables
methods.description: Returns a list of table names from the database that start with the configured prefix.

methods.name: getRecords
methods.description: Retrieves a subset of records from a specified database table, ordered by primary key.

methods.name: getTotalRecords
methods.description: Returns the total number of records in a specified database table.
